entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: 成功は、eligible cohortの分母、観測・欠測・除外・撤回・遅延・追跡不能の分類、理由と責任主体、best/worst bounds、感度結果、governance routingを決定論的に再現し、欠測を品質や成功へ算入せず、npm test・portable・AOF組織検証・公開releaseを完了すること。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: Proceed with the smallest additive calibration-report slice: policy, disposition, sensitivity analysis, assessment, governance, verifier, examples, fixtures, docs, portable release.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: No independently verified operational attrition dataset is committed, so missingness mechanisms, representativeness, statistical validity, calibration truth, and transportability remain unestablished.
entries.expectation_state: Missingness policy, exact outcome dispositions, bounded sensitivity analysis, aggregate assessment, governance, documentation, fixtures, and portable validation are complete; the example remains collecting, example-only, and insufficient.
entries.mismatch_state: No independently verified operational attrition dataset is committed, so missingness mechanisms, representativeness, statistical validity, calibration truth, and transportability remain unestablished.
entries.scale_direction: Implement v0.7.3 Cross-Domain Transportability Review without treating pooled performance as proof of transfer.
